# Butter Pop (G4)

Butter Pop is the lavender Earth pony mare with a bright pink mane and tail, green eyes and a popcorn-like cutie mark seen at the Rainbow Falls Traders Exchange. Think of her as the little cinema-snack-themed pony near the comic-book stall, rather than a recurring Ponyville character.

[![Hasbro Studios — Trade Ya! show still](https://preview.redd.it/does-anyone-know-the-name-of-this-pony-shes-so-cute-v0-wy1i7wgeslz61.jpg?auto=webp&s=eecf8dba33d71339243b13d3f7f65f67baf51caf)](https://www.reddit.com/r/mylittlepony/comments/ne5zs6/does_anyone_know_the_name_of_this_pony_shes_so/)

- **Naming:** The [original fandom naming poll](https://www.reddit.com/r/listofponies/comments/2mfwam/earth_f_coatlavender_manepink_eyesgreen_cmpopcorn/) records Butter Pop being selected on December 14, 2014. The suggestion explicitly referenced the older pony with a similar cutie mark. Fizzy Pop and Calliope were competing suggestions, not established aliases.
- **Namesake:** Hasbro's [2007 G3 Butter Pop toy](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/butterpop.html) was popcorn-scented and had a cinema-themed backcard. The G4 mare appears in official television continuity, but her name is fan-selected; no official cross-generation identity is established.
- **Speaking status:** Apparently non-speaking; no attributable dialogue, voice actor, official G4 name or additional appearance was verified. The [character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) lists only Trade Ya! and describes her mark as popcorn or a float.

## Important moments

- **The Rainbow Falls exchange — Trade Ya! (S4E22, April 19, 2014).** Her brief appearance among the market visitors is the only documented scene; the character index places it around 03:48, but the video timestamp could not be independently verified. [Episode source](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/trade-ya/umc.cmc.2xzi3f82kxotfet84vycu3kij?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j).

No further character-defining scenes or attributed fan artwork could be verified, so the list is intentionally limited to one. The show-still post is accessible, but its direct image and the character index could not be independently reopened by the browser.
